Iron & Grace Teen

Young Men, ages 15–19 · Integrity, courage, responsibility, and servant leadership.

Your discipleship journey

Six days of Scripture, reflection, real-life decisions and memory practice. Day 7 is a weekly Big Picture Gathering. All progress stays in this browser on this device.

Daily challenge

Read the passage in your Bible before answering. Scripture references are memory prompts, not substitutes for reading the text.

Real-life decision

Scripture memory

Read the verse aloud, close your Bible, and recite it from memory. Then reopen your Bible and check accuracy.

Apply it

Weekly Big Picture Gathering

Discuss: Where did you face this week's principle? What did Scripture reveal? Which choice was difficult? How can you encourage another person this week?

Recite the memory verse without looking. Pray for one another. A trusted mentor can guide the conversation.

Rewards with purpose

Earn 20 XP for a thoughtful scenario decision, 10 XP for verified memory practice, and 10 XP for an action step each day. A gathering earns 30 XP. Badges mark consistency and growth—not spiritual worth.

There is no public leaderboard, chat, or personal-data collection. Don't enter private details about yourself or others.
